title: Gone Again With Carter Andrews
description:
S01 E03 — Gone to Virginia
Carter Andrews visits Virginia's Eastern Shore to catch local species, explore regional cuisine and highlight shellfish and algae conservation, joined by his daughter Haley as they tour the area's coastal islands.

title: Hooked on Africa Best of
description:
S02 E16 — Rabid Dogs
It's not the size of the Dog in the Fight but rather the size of the fight in the Dog! Joins us as we get into some of the biggest dog fights yet and revisit all our experiences involving the unique terrier of the deep, The Dogtooth Tuna.

title: Hooked on Travel
description:
S01 E16 — West Coast Estuaries
The estuaries of Angola are the nursery for all fish that roam off its cold Atlantic seaboard, and it's where in certain seasons the Jacks and Tarpon are to be found. Tommo and Wes split up to experiment in two of Angola's most prolific waterways.

title: Reel Africa
description:
S02 E03 — All Teeth No Scales
The coastline surrounding Port Elizabeth is part of the beautiful Wild Coast and is a preferred fishing destination for many an angler.

title: Inside Angling
description:
S01 E05 — The Island
Outer Atolls of the Seychelles Archipelago need to be seen to be believed; when it comes to fishing, this is Nirvana; we go in search of a plethora of species to catch and release using a multitude of lures and angling methods.

title: Wildfly Best of
description:
S02 E16 — Run on the Ranga
Primeval would aptly describe this astonishing landscape and the incredible lakes and river systems that have housed gargantuan fish since the ice age. We visit the South coast of Iceland to experience the prolific Atlantic Salmon run.

title: Wild Fish Wild Places
description:
Oregon Steelhead in the Rain
Denis Isbister and Jarod Higginbotham brave Tillamook's rainy season in search of giant Oregon steelhead.
